generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidder shall not be blacklisted in any department
Rates quoted shall be excluding GST as per circular no. FD 417 Exp-12/2024 dated: 09.08.2024
All terms and conditions are per tender document

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Construction of 100KLD capacity SBR type STP at Halethirumakudalu in T.Narsipura town under 2nd stage UGD scheme to T.Narsipura town (Lumpsum Tender- No variation).

itemList.description: Construction of  100 KLD capacity SBR methodology STP including construction of Receiving chamber, Bar screen chamber, Oil & Grease chamber, Equalization tank, Sludge tank, Sequential Batch Reactor, Decant water tank, Treated water tank, Sludge drying bed and other allied works with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in Charge. (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7: Specifications, Special specifications for all the items)

Supply, erection, electrification and commissioning of Electro-mechanical items to the STP & other allied works with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in Charge. (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7: Specifications, special specifications for all the items)

Construction 6mX4m DG room at STP premises and Compound wall around the STP and other allied works with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in Charge. (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7: Specifications, Special specifications for all the items)

Installation of 11KV express feeder main and other allied works with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in Charge. (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7: Specifications, Special specifications for all the items)

Supplying and laying UNPLASTICISED PVC pipes conforming to IS 16098:2013 with latest amendments along with necessary machinehole chambers and UGD House Service Connection and other allied works as per SR specifications for missing UGD network with all lead and lift as directed by the Engineer in Charge. (contractor will make his own arrangements for procuring water for testing) etc. (Shall be read in conjunction with Section 7: Specifications, Special specifications for all the items)
